selected_evidence.requirement: Run the containerized application as unprivileged account appsvc
selected_evidence.summary: Shows appsvc UID 1000 with subordinate ID ranges, nologin shell, Podman rootless=true, and the running appsvc-web container.

selected_evidence.requirement: Serve the web application on port 8080
selected_evidence.summary: Shows persistent/runtime firewall access, a listener on all addresses at TCP/8080, the container port mapping, and HTTP 200 from node1's managed IP.

selected_evidence.requirement: Start at boot while appsvc has no active interactive login session
selected_evidence.summary: Shows the Quadlet boot configuration and, after restart, a generated active user service. appsvc is lingering; its only session is Class=manager/Service=systemd-user with no TTY or remote login.

Captures healthy baseline boot ID e9ff9357-2aac-4d23-83f2-664554ef89e4, reboot acknowledgement, changed boot ID ea5b1912-2dc9-4f5a-ab05-d22a273db208, return to system-running state, and complete application recovery.
